inherited_criterion.roadmap_text: The contribution-positioning text names the comparison set, states the distinct unit of contribution, labels adaptations versus synthesis, and makes no unsupported global novelty claim.

operationalization.fully_addressed: Concrete manuscript evidence identifies the comparison set in the contribution-positioning text, states the manuscript's distinct unit of contribution, distinguishes adaptations from synthesis, and confines every novelty claim to what that comparison supports, with no unsupported global novelty claim.
operationalization.partially_addressed: A genuine contribution-positioning change supplies at least one of the required elements, but the comparison set, distinct unit of contribution, adaptation-versus-synthesis labeling, or support boundary for novelty remains absent, ambiguous, or incomplete.
operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: Relative to the original manuscript, the contribution positioning removes or obscures a comparison or contribution boundary, or introduces or broadens an unsupported global novelty claim.

operationalization.fully_addressed: The reader-facing method can be understood from its scientific evidence-workflow description without knowing project-internal phase or route vocabulary, and any retained workflow history is explicitly presented as provenance rather than as the scientific method.

items.expected_change_surface: Navigation hypothesis only: Executed Methodology and Reproducibility and Prospective Implementation Interface, especially proposed blocks B0048, B0049, and B0080; equivalent evidence elsewhere counts, and location alone does not satisfy the criterion.

inherited_criterion.roadmap_text: Every artifact invoked as an audit basis has a stable locator, version or content digest, access condition, and explicit claim-surface relationship, or the auditability claim is narrowed to what readers can actually inspect.

operationalization.fully_addressed: For every artifact the manuscript invokes as an audit basis, the manuscript supplies a stable locator, a version or content digest, the access condition, and the artifact's explicit relationship to the manuscript claim surface; alternatively, any auditability statement is narrowed so that it covers only material readers can actually inspect.
operationalization.partially_addressed: A genuine change makes some invoked audit artifacts inspectable or narrows part of the auditability claim, but at least one invoked audit basis still lacks a stable locator, version or digest, access condition, or claim-surface relationship, or the claim still exceeds what readers can inspect.
operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: Relative to the original manuscript, the auditability claim is broadened beyond inspectable material, or a stable locator, version or digest, access condition, claim-surface relationship, or existing scope limitation is removed or made less explicit.

items.expected_change_surface: Navigation hypothesis only: Reproducibility and Prospective Implementation Interface and Data and Materials Availability, especially proposed blocks B0080 and B0107; equivalent evidence elsewhere counts, and location alone does not satisfy the criterion.

inherited_criterion.roadmap_text: The reported corpus counts replay from the disclosed row-level ledger, and the final 22 admitted identifiers are hash-linked to the evidence matrix without implying a broader search than was executed.

operationalization.fully_addressed: The disclosed row-level search and screening ledger contains the exact query and run provenance, deduplication rules, raw identifiers, and row decisions needed to reproduce the reported corpus counts; the final 22 admitted identifiers are hash-linked to the evidence matrix; and the scope language does not imply a broader search than the one documented.
operationalization.partially_addressed: A genuine ledger or linkage is added and permits replay of some rows or counts, but the full reported counts cannot yet be reproduced, the 22 admitted identifiers are not completely hash-linked to the evidence matrix, or the stated search scope remains broader than the disclosed execution.
operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: Relative to the original manuscript, search or screening provenance, deduplication rules, row decisions, identifier-to-matrix hash linkage, or the bounded-search qualification is removed or weakened, or the manuscript implies a broader search without corresponding replay evidence.

items.expected_change_surface: Navigation hypothesis only: Executed Methodology, Acknowledged Limitations, and Data and Materials Availability, especially proposed blocks B0048, B0089, and B0107; equivalent evidence elsewhere counts, and location alone does not satisfy the criterion.

inherited_criterion.roadmap_text: Each decision-bearing source-role claim either carries an exact passage locator, hypothesis map, and prohibited-transfer note or is explicitly narrowed while retaining an INCONCLUSIVE claim-to-passage status.

operationalization.fully_addressed: Every decision-bearing source-role claim is individually resolved by one of the criterion's two allowed paths: it carries an exact passage locator together with the applicable hypothesis map and prohibited-transfer note, or it is explicitly narrowed and retains an INCONCLUSIVE claim-to-passage status.
operationalization.partially_addressed: A genuine change resolves some decision-bearing source-role claims or adds part of the required locator, hypothesis, and prohibited-transfer information, but at least one such claim satisfies neither complete allowed path.
operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: Relative to the original manuscript, a decision-bearing source-role claim loses a passage locator, hypothesis boundary, prohibited-transfer note, narrowing, or INCONCLUSIVE status, or an unresolved premise is promoted without satisfying either allowed path.
